about: The reading check's made sounds (make.mjs): what is planted in each, what an agent reading its hearing is to find, and how close is a pass. A pair's second file is heard --against its first.
question: What do you find in this sound? Name anything unusual, and where or how much. If nothing is unusual, say so.

sounds.planted: nothing: the bed, sines at 220 and 330 Hz over pink noise from 40 Hz to 16 kHz, its own noise in each channel
sounds.find: nothing unusual: no fault; the two sines may be named as narrow peaks or held notes
sounds.tolerance: any fault, or any other unusual property named, is a fail

sounds.planted: the bed, with one sample at 5.000 s raised by 4 times the RMS of the 50 ms around it
pink noise at -18 dB RMS and a sine at 3000 Hz 12 dB under it
sounds.find: a narrow peak (a resonance or a held note) near 3 kHz
sounds.tolerance: a sixth of an octave (2670 to 3370 Hz)

sounds.planted: a saw at 55 Hz gated at 6 Hz, 12 dB deep, with pink noise above 300 Hz 12 dB under it
sounds.find: the low band moves at 6 Hz, about 12 dB deep
sounds.tolerance: 0.5 Hz; the depth within 4 dB of 12 dB

sounds.planted: two saws at 440 and 554 Hz dipped 6 dB twice a second, with a 100 ms 60 Hz thump on each dip; heard with --bpm 120
sounds.find: the mid band dips and returns on the beat (quarter notes at 120 bpm, twice a second), about 6 dB; called pumping, or a dip on every beat
sounds.tolerance: on the quarter-note beat; the depth within 3 dB of 6 dB

sounds.planted: the same pink noise in both channels, with noise from 5 to 10 kHz in the sides only
sounds.find: wide in the presence region (5 to 10 kHz) only; narrow or mono everywhere else
sounds.tolerance: the wide part named as the presence region, or as a range inside 4 to 12 kHz

sounds.planted: a 200 Hz sine driven 6 dB past full scale and clipped at it
sounds.find: clipping at full scale (flat tops at 0 dB), all through
sounds.tolerance: clipping named, at or within 0.5 dB of full scale

sounds.planted: pink noise at -18 dB RMS with sines at 60 and 120 Hz, each 6 dB under it (the brief had 12 dB under; there the hum measure finds it in only 9 of 10 noise seeds, so it is planted more plainly)
the pluck sound of dry-pluck.wav with a 375 ms delay, feedback 0.5, 8 repeats (a dotted 1/8 note at 120 bpm); heard with --bpm 120
sounds.find: an echo, repeats every 375 ms (a dotted 1/8 note at 120 bpm), each quieter than the one before
sounds.tolerance: 10 ms; the repeats named as an echo (or as a note played again more quietly); the digital silence between the notes may be named and is not a fail

sounds.find: the sound bright.wav is read against; asked about only as part of the pair

sounds.planted: the same pink noise as dull.wav, with noise from 5 to 16 kHz added at the same level
sounds.find: bright.wav is brighter than dull.wav, and the difference is above 5 kHz (presence and air)
sounds.tolerance: brighter named, and the place named as presence or air, or a range inside 4 to 20 kHz

sounds.planted: a 55 Hz sine peaking at -6 dB
sounds.find: the sound distorted-bass.wav is read against; asked about only as part of the pair

sounds.planted: the same 55 Hz sine driven 18 dB and clipped at half scale
sounds.find: distorted-bass.wav is distorted (rough, clipped or flat-topped, with harmonics clean-bass.wav does not have)
sounds.unit: dB full scale, the clipping level
sounds.tolerance: distortion, roughness, clipping or flat tops named; a level, if given, within 1 dB of -6 dB

sounds.planted: the pluck sound: eight saw notes (C4 E4 G4 C5 A4 F4 D4 B3), 0.25 s each, one every 0.75 s, each fading from its start, then silence to 8 s
sounds.find: the sound wet-pluck.wav is read against; asked about only as part of the pair

sounds.planted: the same pluck sound through a made reverb with a 2 s RT60, mixed half wet
sounds.find: wet-pluck.wav rings on after its notes end and dry-pluck.wav stops at once: a longer decay, and more of it is tail (a reverb)
sounds.unit: ms, the decay (the time to fall 20 dB: a third of the reverb's 2 s)
sounds.tolerance: the longer decay or more tail named; a decay, if given, within 35% of 667 ms (430 to 900 ms); a register or top line said to rise is not a fail (a reverb lifts those readings, a stated limit)

sounds.planted: a melody of saw notes, half a second each, up the C major scale from C3 to C4 and back down (16 notes, 8 s), each fading from its start
sounds.find: the sound high-melody.wav is read against; asked about only as part of the pair

sounds.planted: the same melody an octave higher (C4 to C5)
sounds.find: high-melody.wav is the same melody an octave higher: its pitched parts and its top line sit an octave above low-melody.wav's
sounds.tolerance: higher named, by about an octave (0.75 to 1.25 octaves, or the notes named an octave apart)

sounds.planted: a held pad of C3, E3 and G3 saws, each peaking at -12 dB
sounds.find: the sound busy.wav is read against; asked about only as part of the pair

sounds.planted: the same pad, with a hat (noise over 7 kHz, 50 ms, peaking at -14 dB) on every 1/16 note at 120 bpm (8 a second) and a second melody over it (the scale from C5 to C6 and back, half a second a note, peaking at -12 dB)
sounds.find: busy.wav is busier: many more notes or hits start each second (about 8, the hats) than in sparse.wav (a held pad, almost none), and a higher part plays over the pad
sounds.tolerance: more onsets (or busier) named; a rate, if given, within 2 of 8 a second
